note: Given 1.9.13, the x-coordinate is bounded by X(tau), which depends only on tau. The admissibility alternative gives 0 <= y_Q <= 1 directly in one case, while in the convex-hull case y_Q is a convex combination of the actor y-coordinates 0, a*t, t, 0, and 1, all lying in [0,1]. Thus every admissible pair lies in the stated compact rectangle, whose bounds are independent of I and of the number of nonactor fibers; interpreting the alternatives inclusively as 'at least one' is sufficient.
